messages.author: a85677f5b3c5919a
messages.subject: Distance problem
parts:
Dear all,

I am using Distance 6 R2 to analize a line transect survey and I am having
some troubles. When I import the data I notice that the program does not
import the rows in which no animals were observed. I have Windows 7 and I
thought that was the problem but then I used Windows XP but it happened
again. I did the Example 1 (Distance sample projects) and, as I think it
must be, rows with no sights do appear in the data layers. I have stored the
data in *txt file and I can see the rows without observations. Before I used
the previos version Distance 5 R2, and nothing like that had happened.

Any help would be great!

Thank you
Sofia Tello

messages.subject: Re: Distance problem
parts:
Sofia, Check you have the same number of delimiters in every row - for
example in the semicolon delimited data from the distance help file
(below), the 7th line has a semicolon after the line length of 5.7 but
no distance. If you still can't figure it out, email me (off the list)
and I'll have a look. Cheers, - Len Thomas
